name: Wework India Management Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2016, WeWork India Management Limited is a flexible workspace operator in India.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1][2]
WeWork India Management, majority owned and promoted by Embassy Group, is India’s leading premium flexible workspace operator. As of June  2025, it operated 68 centres with an aggregate leasable area of 7.67 million sq. ft. and 1,14,077 desks across eight Tier‑1 cities. The company is the exclusive licensee of the WeWork brand in India, enabling access to a globally recognized name in flexible workspaces.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 20.6% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -26.4%
